verdict_reason: The rewritten test correctly proves the review's Back after Continue from the addresses page, but its title misstates what Back opens.

todos.issue: In the describe 'Back on the review page', the new title 'after Continue from the addresses page it opens check your answers, whose Back opens the addresses hub' reads as if Back on the review opens check your answers. The test proves that Continue opens the review and the review's Back opens the addresses page (lines 11-15). The title also gives one page two names: 'the addresses page' and 'the addresses hub'.
todos.fix: Must: the title says Back on a review reached by Continue from the addresses page opens the addresses page, and uses one name for that page. One way: 'reached by Continue from the addresses page it opens the addresses page'.
